title.value: Monitoring non-pharmaceutical public health interventions during the COVID-19 pandemic
title.justification: The title is derived directly from the heading of the paper.
title.quote: Monitoring non-pharmaceutical public health interventions during the COVID-19 pandemic

analysis.description: This paper discusses the challenges of measuring and monitoring non-pharmaceutical interventions (NPIs) during the COVID-19 pandemic worldwide. The authors highlight the need for integrating multiple databases to improve the documentation and comparison of these interventions, emphasizing the importance of consistent definitions, geographical and social representation, and accurate timing documentation. The paper also reviews existing databases and discusses the challenges of using crowd-sourced data to track interventions.

type.justification: The paper provides empirical data and analyses on the state of NPI databases, along with comparative statistics and practical challenges observed in the field.
type.quote: ...we present three of the most important challenges for projects that use crowd-sourcing to capture a wide spectrum of non-pharmaceutical public health interventions worldwide.

name.justification: The paper focuses on the use of databases and data integration for public health monitoring, specifically related to non-pharmaceutical interventions during the COVID-19 pandemic.
name.quote: ...the importance of integrating and triangulating across multiple databases and the need to expand and fund the mandate for public health organizations to track interventions systematically.

name.justification: The paper includes discussions on interventions aimed at controlling the spread of COVID-19, which is a primary concern in epidemiology.
name.quote: ...heterogeneous strategies have been used, implementing different interventions with variable stringency throughout the epidemic trajectory.

name.justification: The paper deals extensively with data challenges such as classification, data integration, and data quality, which are central topics in data science.
name.quote: Another approach to integrating multiple databases is creating an online directory of open databases tracking government policies.

name.justification: The paper references the OxCGRT as one of the comprehensive trackers for documenting NPIs globally.
name.quote: ...such as the Oxford COVID-19 Government Response Tracker (OxCGRT, https://covidtracker.bsg.ox.ac.uk/)
